caption: The drawing displays a shield-shaped emblem with a muted olive-green outline and a black interior. Centered on the shield are three pale, beige-colored medieval objects arranged in a crossed and layered fashion. From left to right, there is a long trumpet facing upward and to the left; next to it, a thin, straight object resembling a baton or staff, slightly crossed with the trumpet and extending upward; and at the right, a sword with a curved cross guard and a rounded pommel, set diagonally across the other two objects. Above the items is a ribbon or banner, also rendered in a light beige color, that curves horizontally across the top portion of the shield. The background outside the shield is off-white or light beige, with no other markings or objects present.
title: Cartouche from Salem Gate
